data.name: Black Sheep / Aliver "Pillbug" Podiker (apothecary)
data.description: Everyone suspects sweaty, shifty-eyed Pillbug sells poisons from his cluttered, acrid smelling wreck of a shop. You're one of the few in town who know this for a fact. You start the game with 400 gp worth of poison, and Pillbug will continue to sell you poison as long as you don't spread the word.
